name: security
description: Is it safe? security-sweep is the entry point: a multi-agent OWASP, STRIDE, secrets, supply-chain and LLM-security audit of the repository with a verifier fan-out and a CSO report. To go deeper on one area, use security-threat-model, security-and-hardening or security-best-practices. For agent code: agent-security-hardening, mcp-dependency-review and skill-security-auditor. Guardrails for Claude Code: block-no-verify-hook and git-guardrails-claude-code, which install hooks only when invoked. Vendored skills are credited in NOTICE.md.
